description: She wears a rust-red floor-length gown with a low square neckline, shaped bodice and elbow sleeves, edged with gold geometric embroidered borders. A decorated woven belt with round clasp and hanging ornamental ends secures the waist; a cream-gold fringed wrap rests along the arms. A pendant, small earrings, wrist cuff and embroidered gold-brown shoes are visible. An opaque cream underdress shows at the central lower opening. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
